title: Spider
html:
See Phase Spider for the monstrosity.

Spiders are a type of Beast and non-playable race in Baldur's Gate 3.

“
Eight-legged, spindly, and generally awful.
„
— In-game racial description

About spiders

Spiders are a type of arthropod that can create  Web surfaces.

Spiders are often kept by Drow, as familiars or mounts. The most influential drow goddess,  Lolth, is also known as the Queen of Spiders. Cultures which revere Lolth forbid killing spiders.

Non-hostile Spiders can be spoken to using  Speak with Animals. A spider companion,  Aranea (Wolf Spider Companion), is available to Beast Master Rangers.

Racial features

Base Racial Speed
9m / 30ft
Size
Tiny or Small or Medium
Darkvision
Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).
Web Walker
Isn't slowed down by  Web surfaces, and can't be  Enwebbed by them.

See also

  • Kar'niss - a drider; a drow who is partially transformed into a spider, this happens typically as punishment for failing a test of Lolth
